items.action: Append `-color` to every DS token whose name ends in `-bg`, and insert it after `-bg` in the state variants `--ds-*-bg-<state>` (`--ds-button-bg-hover` becomes `--ds-button-bg-color-hover`, `--ds-toast-bg-error` becomes `--ds-toast-bg-color-error`). Covers the public `--ds-<component>-…-bg` hooks on avatar, badge, banner, button, card, date-picker, dropzone, empty-state, icon-button, input, modal, pagination, search, sidenav, stat, table, tabs, tag, toast and topbar, plus the globals `--select-bg`, `--chart-hover-bg`, `--chart-tooltip-bg` and the `--status-<x>-bg` set.
items.appliesWhen: Only to DS-owned tokens. Your own variables ending in `-bg` are untouched, and the private `--_*` internals renamed in lockstep have no public hook, so they need nothing.
items.pitfall: A blind search-and-replace on `-bg` renames YOUR variables too, and the result still compiles — a custom property resolves to nothing and the element silently loses its background. Before replacing a name, confirm the `-color` spelling exists in the installed 0.3.0 package under `themes/` or `styles/`; if it does not, the token was yours.
items.note: The tokens held only a colour and now feed `background-color`, so the name says which property it reaches.

items.action: For each `-fg` token you override, look the replacement up in the 0.3.0 token reference on the documentation site, which lists every `--ds-*`; the global roles are also readable in the installed package under `themes/` and `styles/`. Three suffixes are in play and the split is real: at 0.3.0 the package exposes 16 `--ds-*-text-color`, 30 `-label-color` and 10 `-icon-color` hooks (state variants such as `-hover` included). A state variant keeps its state after the new suffix: `--ds-tab-fg-hover` becomes `--ds-tab-label-color-hover`, `--ds-modal-title-fg-error` becomes `--ds-modal-title-text-color-error`.
items.appliesWhen: Only to DS-owned tokens. A variable of your own ending in `-fg` is untouched.
items.pitfall: The suffix is NOT derivable from the old name, so guessing produces a name nothing reads and a silently unstyled element. Same shape, three answers: `--ds-modal-title-fg` became `--ds-modal-title-text-color`, `--ds-sidenav-group-fg` became `--ds-sidenav-group-label-color`, `--ds-icon-button-fg` became `--ds-icon-button-icon-color`.
items.note: The `fg` abbreviation was dropped for a suffix that says what the token paints — text, a control or nav label, or a glyph. It covers the public `--ds-<component>-…-fg` hooks on avatar, badge, banner, breadcrumbs, button, date-picker, dropzone, empty-state, icon-button, input, menu, modal, page-header, pagination, search, sidenav, table, tabs, tag and topbar, plus the `--status-*` globals and `--chart-tooltip-fg`.
items.verify: No stylesheet declares or reads a --ds-*-fg or --ds-*-fg-<state> token, --chart-tooltip-fg or a --status-*-fg token; each one names the semantic replacement its component reads (-text-color / -label-color / -icon-color).

items.action: Read every caption you pass in `[steps]` as on-screen text and reword the ones written to be heard rather than seen. `labelPosition` (`bottom` | `inline`, default `bottom`) sets where they sit; where a stepper sits in a compact row beside other content, set `labelPosition="inline"`. Style the captions through `--ds-stepper-label-color`, `--ds-stepper-label-color-current` and `--ds-stepper-label-font-size`.
items.pitfall: Nothing breaks and no build fails, so this ships unless somebody looks. Captions authored for a screen reader tend to carry the context the screen already gives — "Step 2 of 5: enter your details" reads fine when announced and badly when printed under a numbered dot. A rule of yours on `ds-stepper .bar` now matches nothing: the connector is `.connector`, inside each step, and under `bottom` its width is the segment's, not a fixed length.
items.note: `[steps]` takes a `readonly string[]`, and those strings used to be screen-reader-only: on screen a step showed only its number. They render as visible labels now.
items.verify: Every caption passed in [steps] is written to be READ on screen, not only announced - they render visibly now, every stepper placed in a compact row sets labelPosition="inline", and no stylesheet targets ds-stepper .bar.
items.appliesWhen: Every `ds-stepper`. Under the default `labelPosition` (`bottom`) the host is `display: flex` where it was `inline-flex`, each step takes an equal share of the row, and the connector spans from node centre to node centre, so `--stepper-bar-w` sizes it only under `labelPosition="inline"`.

items.action: Build after upgrading, then rename your own member or mark it `override` wherever the compiler reports a collision with a class in `detect`. Delete an override of a member the class lost.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class that extends one of the classes in `detect`. A consumer who uses the elements in templates needs nothing from this item.
items.pitfall: `private` and `protected` give no protection: a member you redeclare collides with a base member of any visibility. A member of yours that replaced a lost one no longer replaces anything, and the component stops calling it.
items.note: `ComboboxComponent` gained `size`. `DrawerComponent` gained `onEscape`. `InputComponent`, `SelectComponent` and `TextareaComponent` each gained 11, the reactive-forms bridge: `writeValue`, `registerOnChange`, `registerOnTouched`, `setDisabledState` and their private state. `StepperComponent` gained `connectorClass` and `labelPosition` and lost `barClass`.
items.verify: The app builds with no error naming a class listed in `detect`, and every member of such a subclass that shares a base member's name is marked `override`.

informational: Reactive-forms (ControlValueAccessor) on ds-input / ds-textarea / ds-select ([(value)] signal API unchanged, both work) — additive.

ng add support (wires the global styles import idempotently); ds-combobox size input (+ComboboxSize); overridable focus-ring token system (--ds-field-focus-shadow / --ds-control-focus-shadow groups + per-component --ds-<comp>-focus-shadow hooks, default appearance unchanged except ds-combobox, which moves to the field halo); ds-tag hover label hook `--ds-tag-hover-label-color` (the hover background hook existed and is renamed above); --opacity-state-active overlay token — all additive.

Visual-only: tag close button gains a pressed state; accordion & sidenav-group animate open/close; the collapsed body stays in the DOM marked inert (accordion: instead of `@if` removal; sidenav-group: instead of `display: none`); ds-combobox focus uses the soft field halo; repo-wide value-preserving CSS modernization (background-color precision, modern hsl()/clip-path/range media syntax).
Fixes: ds-drawer closes on Escape when focus left the panel; ds-combobox 'No matches' row (role=option, aria-disabled) now also carries aria-selected="false".
